content: श्यामा .²1 Night, particularly a dark night; श्यामां श्यामलिमनमानयत भोः सान्द्रैर्मषीकूर्चकैः <ls>Vb. 3. 1</ls>. .²2 Shade, shadow. .²3 A dark woman. .²4 A kind of woman (यौवनमध्यस्था according to <ls>Malli.</ls> on <ls>N. 3. 8</ls>; <ls>Śi. 8. 36</ls>; <ls>Me. 84</ls>; or शीते सुखोष्णसर्वाङ्गी ग्रीष्मे या सुखशीतला . तप्तकाञ्चनवर्णाभा सा स्त्री श्यामेति कथ्यते according to one commentator on <ls>Bk. 5. 18</ls> and 8. 100). .²5 A woman who has borne no children. .²6 A cow. .²7 Turmeric. .²8 The female cuckoo. .²9 The Priyaṅgu creeper; कृत्वा श्यामाविटपसदृशं स्रस्तमुक्तं द्वितीयम् <ls>M. 2. 7</ls>; <ls>Me. 106</ls>. .²10 The indigo plant. .²11 The holy basil. .²12 The seed of the lotus. .²13 <ab>N.</ab> of the Yamunā. .²14 <ab>N.</ab> of several plants. .²15 A name or form of Durgā (worshipped by the Tāntrikas).
